diagnostics.method_selection: Exact when either group has at most 8 glands and there are no pooled ties; otherwise asymptotic with tie and continuity correction.
diagnostics.comparison_family: Each nonzero dose versus DMSO (0); Holm correction within this outcome.
diagnostics.interpretation: Rank-based independent-group comparison; not a test of mean difference or, without common distribution shape, a pure median test.
diagnostics.rank_effect: 2*U_b/(n_a*n_b)-1: positive means larger values tend to occur in dose B; ties contribute half to U.

input_audit.pairing: Explicit cohort, group and gland number; filename-record joins are one-to-one.
input_audit.exclusion_policy: Only explicitly enabled filename-marked placeholders and acquisition days outside the selected interval; no count threshold filter.
